chapter_title_en: The Trial of the Great Sinners
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 376 – Ji Ning Learns the True Scope of the Firewing King’s Hunt
chapter_meta_description: Qi Rufeng reveals the true horror of the Firewing Toxin—a soul-staining mark that makes escape impossible. Ji Ning sets his sights on the twelve demon kings of the Eaststream.
og_title: Desolate Era 376 – The Toxin That Never Fades
og_description: Ji Ning takes a disciple and immediately learns why the Qi Kingdom royals have been hunted for decades. The Eaststream Twelve Demon Kings just became his new target.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 376 – Ji Ning’s Next Prey
twitter_description: The twelve demon kings of the Eaststream are infamous, and their leader once fought a Celestial Immortal to a standstill. Ji Ning’s battle intent is rising.

lore_anchors.definition: A specially refined poison that merges with the victim’s body and soul upon contact, causing no direct harm but allowing the caster’s Firewing Insects to track the victim’s location from any distance.
A sworn brotherhood of twelve powerful demon kings ruling the Eaststream region of the Star Continent, each possessing vast karmic sin visible as a bloody aura.
A being with massive karmic sin; in xianxia cultivation, such an aura often appears as a towering, ocean-like bloody light visible to divine sense.
A common xianxia cultivation trial requiring a cultivator to balance the karmic scales by either taking a high-merit disciple or killing high-sin demons.
The middle-ranked demon king responsible for the destruction of the Qi Kingdom; a Firewing Insect cultivator capable of deploying the Firewing Toxin.
The strongest of the twelve demon kings, reputed to have fought a Celestial Immortal to a standstill, forcing the immortal to retreat.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a special poison that merges with a victim’s body and soul, doing no harm but permanently marking them for tracking by the Firewing King’s insects.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Qi Kingdom survivors remove the poison?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Even Earth Immortals and Loose Immortals are unable to remove it, as it stains the soul itself.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Eight-Nine Arcane Art's trial?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It requires the cultivator to take one disciple and kill ten "great sinners"—beings with massive karmic sin visible as a bloody aura.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the strongest of the twelve demon kings?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The first-ranked Golden Mane Bear King, who once fought a Celestial Immortal to a standstill and forced the immortal to retreat.
